_comment: Faction colour sets. Applying one writes the three palette channels and the material preset, leaving per-part colour overrides untouched, so a faction repaint never destroys hand-picked detail colours.

factions.name: Terran Coalition Navy
factions.desc: Institutional grey-blue with gold trim. Built in state yards, inspected twice, painted exactly to spec.

factions.name: Free Traders' Union
factions.desc: Cream hulls and union green. Cheerful, slightly shabby, and welcome at every independent dock in the sector.

factions.name: Crimson Reach
factions.desc: Scavenged plate in oxide red with hazard orange flashes. Nothing matches; that is the point.

factions.name: Vega Industrial
factions.desc: Contractor yellow over bare structural grey. Every panel stencilled, every warning label present and legible.

factions.name: Kethral Compact
factions.desc: Deep violet shell with cyan channel lines. Non-human yards, non-human proportions, unmistakable at any range.

factions.name: Unpainted / Yard Fresh
factions.desc: Primer grey with a single safety stripe. What a hull looks like before anyone has decided who it belongs to.
